correctness.rationale: For any finite simple connected cactus order>=3, every connected dominating set includes every cut vertex (otherwise two components of G-v cannot both be dominated from a connected selected set). Noncut vertices are leaves or each belong to exactly one cycle. For a cycle block, omitting >2 consecutive free vertices leaves an undominated middle vertex; omitting two disjoint runs splits selected vertices, with no bypass in the block-cut tree. Thus each cycle permits omission of zero/one/two adjacent free vertices, independent across cycles and leaves; this bijection gives x^a(1+x)^ell product over cycles of (x^q+q x^(q-1)+t x^(q-2)); q=0 and q=1 cases interpreted without negative powers, K1 and K2 separate. The discriminant q²-4t is >=0 for q=2 (t<=1), q=3 with articulation (t<=2), q>=4 (t<=q), and is negative exactly for the isolated triangle (q=t=3). Hence all nontriangle cactus roots real nonpositive and coefficient log-concavity/unimodality. Fresh independent subset enumeration for many connected tree/cactus samples confirms full polynomial and triangle exception, not infinite substitute.
